premises.text: App users need data continuity across devices, but existing backends are platform-locked, slow to build, or expensive at scale
premises.evidence_span: lack of data continuity across devices

premises.text: Nimbus Base stores app data in users' personal clouds like Dropbox and Google Drive for sync across mobile and web
premises.evidence_span: leverage app users' personal clouds, like Dropbox and Google Drive, to store app data

premises.text: Data is stored locally first and syncs when online, supporting offline use
premises.evidence_span: If you're offline, that data is first stored locally and then synced to be online when you do have a connection

premises.text: Users can personally delete app data from their own cloud for security confidence
premises.evidence_span: you can personally delete your data for your apps

premises.text: Developers integrate with a few lines of code, cut backend setup from months to minutes, and pay no storage costs because hosting is offloaded to personal-cloud providers
premises.evidence_span: we completely remove the server from the app development equation

premises.text: Developers pay for a license; app users do not pay for the backend storage
premises.evidence_span: it's a developer who pays for a license and not the app user

value.text: Developers get an easy free-to-scale everywhere backend and users get continuous data across devices with control
value.evidence_span: a back end that's easy to implement, free to scale, and works everywhere

causal_links.evidence_span: to have data sync across different devices, they first need a back end
data is instantly synced between the two
he can scale from one user to millions for free

notes: iCloud/self-build/BaaS alternatives folded into one backend-problem premise (§4.1.6). Personal-cloud store, offline sync, and user delete folded as facets of the Personal Cloud mechanism with delete as security facet (§4.1.7). Time and money savings for developers folded as one developer-value package (§4.1.8) with license as commercial detail. Anti-template: problem, sync product, and developer economics separately revisable.
